verification.summary: Moving the boundary list under docs/Factory/v3 brought it inside the NL-pilot lint target for the first time; the pilot flagged V3-G009 on the runtime-authority bullet, which was corrected to `remain outside current approval and separately governed` with no loss of force, after which advisory lint, readiness eval, NL pilot, mission-record lint, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks all passed.

notes: Docs-only change with no new dependencies or code paths.
All nineteen boundary bullets were relocated verbatim except the single V3-G009 wording correction, which strengthens rather than weakens the statement.
The README retains a one-paragraph approval-status summary and a single link to the relocated boundaries, so the front door still states that only V3-OP-001 is approved.
Scope stayed inside the README restructure and boundary relocation.
No promotion, required gate, routing, runtime authority, live integration, real-data, deployment, or V2-removal scope was added.

friction_notes: Boundary language drafted in the README was never covered by the docs/Factory/v3 advisory lints; relocating it immediately surfaced a V3-G009 finding, which suggests other approval-adjacent prose living outside the lint target may carry unchecked wording risk.
This record was authored during the mission, addressing the backfill-quality friction noted in MR_20260610_008.
false_positive_notes: The V3-G009 NL-pilot finding on the relocated runtime-authority bullet is classified as an accepted true positive, not a false positive.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the final advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Relocating governance prose into the linted docs/Factory/v3 tree gives boundary language advisory coverage it lacked in the README; future governance prose should default to living inside the lint target.
